definition: The organelle that breaks down glucose to make ATP, the energy currency the cell actually spends.
connection: Why my legs burn during a long practice - muscle cells run out of oxygen and the mitochondria can't keep up with demand.

definition: Water moving across a semipermeable membrane from where solute is dilute to where it's concentrated.
connection: Salting a driveway before a storm pulls water out of the ice, and it's the same reason salted fries go limp.

definition: An organism actively holding its internal conditions steady even while the outside environment changes.
connection: A robot's PID loop does the same job - constantly correcting to hold a setpoint instead of drifting.

definition: Plants using light energy to turn CO2 and water into glucose and oxygen.
connection: Every bit of the oxygen I breathe in the quad came out of a leaf or an ocean algae doing this.

definition: A protein that speeds up a specific chemical reaction without being used up itself.
connection: Lactase pills work because they hand your gut the exact enzyme it's missing.

definition: Particles spreading from high concentration to low until they're evenly spread out.
connection: Smelling cookies from the other end of the house before anyone tells me they're out of the oven.
